/**
 * @param context The rule context.
 * @returns The result of this check.
 */
function getDOMPropertyNames(context: RuleContext) {
    return ([] as string[]).concat(
        DOM_PROPERTY_NAMES_TWO_WORDS,
        DOM_PROPERTY_NAMES_ONE_WORD,

        testReactVersion(context, '>= 16.1.0')
            ? ([] as string[]).concat(
                testReactVersion(context, '>= 16.4.0')
                    ? ([] as string[]).concat(
                        // these were added in React v16.4.0, see
                        // https://reactjs.org/blog/2018/05/23/react-v-16-4.html and
                        // https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/12507
                        REACT_ON_PROPS,
                        testReactVersion(context, '>= 19')
                            ? [
                                // precedence was added in React v19, see
                                // https://react.dev/blog/2024/04/25/react-19#support-for-stylesheets
                                'precedence',
                            ]
                            : [],
                    )
                    : [],
            )
            : [
                // this was removed in React v16.1+, see https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/10823
                'allowTransparency',
            ],
    );
}
